_readme: Verification dates for the Our Commitments tiles on /trust.
This file is the only place a date lives. To re-verify a commitment,
change its value below and deploy — the tile markup in index.html is not
touched. Keys match the data-verified attribute on each tile's back face.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD. The page renders it as '26 August 2026'.
A key with a missing or malformed date renders no line at all, which is
the intended behaviour for a commitment that has not been verified yet.
